entry: Fixed an OSINT pipeline that was extracting 4 data points from 154 collected. The extractor was written against imagined tool output shapes — google-dorks alone was silently dropping 222 results. Fixed extraction logic for 3 tool types. Also built async job pattern for the server — POST now returns in 0.04s, timer counts up, investigations run in background. What mattered: the code actually worked when it ran. That's the job.
